name: Asset Reference Report
description: Every dam:Asset under a DAM folder with its title/format/replication status, plus each page that references it (via AEM ReferenceSearch) and that page's status. One run per DAM folder.

inputs.label: DAM folder paths — one per line (each produces its own file)
Excluded asset folders — one per line (skipped entirely)
Excluded reference roots
inputs.help: Reference hits under these paths are ignored. /content/dam drops asset-to-asset references.

inputs.label: Asset formats (empty = all types)
inputs.help: Matches the resolved format (dc:format, then dam:MIMEtype), case-insensitive.

inputs.label: Include assets with no references (status 'No Reference')

batch.label: Batch: process large paths (e.g. /content/dam) in smaller requests, still one file per entered path
